column85: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IS EXPECTED TO PLAY AN INCREASINGLY IMPORTANT ROLE IN FUTURE MILITARY OPERATIONS. HOWEVER, DEALING WITH THE VAST AMOUNT OF DATA PRESENTS A MAJOR CHALLENGE FOR AI SYSTEMS. THE CONVENTIONAL APPROACH OF RELYING ON CLUSTERS OF HIGH-PERFORMANCE COMPUTERS FOR AI TASKS MAY NOT BE FEASIBLE IN A BATTLEFIELD SCENARIO. MOREOVER, EVEN IF SUCH CLUSTERS ARE DEPLOYED, THEY REMAIN VULNERABLE TO CYBER OR PHYSICAL ATTACKS, POSING A THREAT TO THE MISSIONS RESILIENCE.

(3) IDENTIFY STRATEGIES TO ENHANCE THE EFFICIENCY OF DIRECT PHOTOEXCITATION DRIVEN CHEMICAL REACTIONS ON METAL NANOPARTICLES. (4) DEMONSTRATE CONTROL OF REACTION SELECTIVITY BY RESONANCE BETWEEN VISIBLE PHOTON EXCITATION AND ELECTRONIC TRANSITIONS LOCALIZED IN TARGETED ADSORBATE-METAL BONDS.

column88: THE OVERARCHING OBJECTIVE OF THIS PROPOSAL IS TO EVALUATE THE USE OF BLOW FLIES AS SENSORS FOR DETERMINING THE FATE AND TRANSPORT OF INSENSITIVE MUNITION (IM) COMPONENTS IN THE ENVIRONMENT. BLOW FLIES WILL BE UTILIZED BECAUSE THEY ARE UBIQUITOUS IN THE ENVIRONMENT, ARE EASILY ATTRACTED AND TRAPPED USING BAIT, AND SAMPLE THEIR ENVIRONMENT AVIDLY. THIS PROJECT WILL SEEK TO ANSWER TWO MAJOR QUESTIONS TO ESTABLISH THE FEASIBILITY OF THIS APPROACH. FIRST, CAN IM COMPONENTS AND THE ENVIRONMENTAL DEGRADATION PRODUCTS BE DETECTED IN THE BLOW FLY AFTER ENVIRONMENTALLY REASONABLE EXPOSURES? SECOND, IS IT POSSIBLE TO DETERMINE, THROUGH INSTRUMENTAL ANALYSIS, THE TYPES OF SUBSTRATES BLOW FLIES HAVE INTERACTED WITH (E.G., SOIL, WATER, CARRION, FECES)? ADDRESSING THIS QUESTION WILL ENABLE DETERMINATION OF THE TRANSPORT OF IM COMPONENTS IN THE ENVIRONMENT.

column85: THE U.S. ARMY RESEARCH OFFICE (ARO) IS SOLICITING PROPOSALS FOR ESTABLISHING A MULTIIDISCIPLINARY RESEARCH CENTER FOR EXTREME-RADIO-FREQUENCY ELECTRONICS (X-RF ELECTRONICS) BASED ON ULTRA-WIDE BANDGAP (UWBG) SEMICONDUCTORS AND RELATED EMERGING MATERIALS. THE UWBG RF ELECTRONICS CENTER TO BE CREATED WILL FACILITATE COLLABORATION BETWEEN EXTRAMURAL ACADEMIC RESEARCHERS AND THE ARMY IN PURSUIT OF A MUTUAL GOAL: GENERATING THE FOUNDATIONAL KNOWLEDGE IN SOLID-STATE PHYSICS, DEVICE STRUCTURES, INTEGRATED CIRCUIT DESIGN, MATERIALS DISCOVERY AND DEVELOPMENT, AND PHYSICS-BASED MACHINE LEARNING NEEDED TO ENABLE THE NEXT GENERATION OF RF ELECTRONICS WITH UNPRECEDENTED POWER, BANDWIDTH, FREQUENCY AGILITY, AND SIZE-WEIGHT-AND-POWER (SWAP) REQUIREMENTS. THIS NECESSITATES NOVEL RESEARCH THAT MOVES BEYOND THE FREQUENCY, POWER AND NOISE CONSTRAINTS IMPOSED BY CURRENT APPROACHES TO MODELING, MATERIALS, AND ESTABLISHED DEVICE STRUCTURES. THE CENTER WILL PROVIDE THE ARMY WITH A NEW ABILITY TO CREATE ADVANCED RF TECHNOLOGIES ACROSS ITS MODERNIZATION PRIORITIES FOR ROBUST MULTI-DOMAIN OPERATIONS IN HIGHLY CONTESTED ELECTROMAGNETIC (EM) ENVIRONMENTS.

column85: THE DEPARTMENT OF THE AIR FORCE DAF IS SOLICITING WHITE PAPERS FROM A UNIVERSITY THE PERFORMER TO DEVELOP AND OPERATE AN AFRL REGIONAL RESEARCH CONVERGENCE HUB ARRCH, AS A COMPLIMENT TO THE DAF CURRENT LABORATORY STRUCTURE. THE ARRCH WILL ENABLE RAPID INVENTION OF TRANSFORMATIONAL CAPABILITIES RELEVANT TO BOTH THE U.S. AIR FORCE USAF AND THE U.S. SPACE FORCE USSF THROUGH THE AGILE PURSUIT OF THE MOST IMPACTFUL RESEARCH, AS REFERENCED IN THE AF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY STRATEGY AFSTS. THE AFSTS DIRECTS AIR FORCE SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY S AND T ORGANIZATIONS TO ENABLE THE AGILITY NECESSARY FOR TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCES TO RAPIDLY EVOLVE INTO TRANSFORMATIONAL AIR FORCE CAPABILITIES. AFSTS OBJECTIVE III CALLS FOR EXPANDING THE AIR FORCES SCIENTIFIC PRESENCE IN INNOVATION HOTSPOTS, FUNDING RESEARCH IN UNIVERSITIES AND PARTNERSHIPS. THE ARRCH WILL BE LED BY A PERFORMER WHO DEMONSTRATES A VALIDATED RECORD OF RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT, BUSINESS INCUBATION ENTREPRENEURSHIP, AND WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT. THE PERFORMER WILL ENTER INTO A COOPERATIVE AGREEMENT WITH THE AIR FORCE RESEARCH LABORATORY AFRL, AND, WITH INPUT FROM AFRL, WILL IMPLEMENT A CONCEPT OF OPERATIONS ENABLING FULL AND SUBSTANTIVE COLLABORATION ACROSS A REGIONAL NETWORK OF MEMBER NODES COMPRISED OF ADDITIONAL ACADEMIC INSTITUTIONS, INDUSTRY, VENTURE FIRMS, NATIONAL LABORATORIES, AND OTHER R AND D ORGANIZATIONS. THIS COLLABORATIVE VISION LEADERSHIP WILL LEVERAGE THEIR RESPECTIVE WORLD CLASS RESEARCH, PERSONNEL, AND ENTREPRENEURIAL PROGRAMS TO CREATE A MORE PHYSICAL AND VISIBLE AF GATEWAY THAT INCREASES THE DISCOVERY, INNOVATION, AND TRANSLATION OF TECHNOLOGY OF INTEREST TO THE USAF AND USSF. A KEY CHARACTERISTIC OF THE ARRCH IS A VIBRANT RESEARCH COMMUNITY, AGILE ADMINISTRATION AND A WORKFORCE CONCEPT COMPRISED OF S AND ES FROM ALL THE MEMBER INSTITUTIONS WORKING WITHIN INTEGRATED MULTIPLE MEMBER MULTI DISCIPLINARY TEAMS TO EXECUTE JOINT RESEARCH LEVERAGING EACH OTHERS FACILITIES AND UNIQUE EXPERTISE.

column85: THE DEPARTMENT OF THE AIR FORCE DAF IS SOLICITING WHITE PAPERS FROM A UNIVERSITY THE PERFORMER TO DEVELOP AND OPERATE AN AFRL REGIONAL RESEARCH CONVERGENCE HUB ARRCH, AS A COMPLIMENT TO THE DAF CURRENT LABORATORY STRUCTURE. THE ARRCH WILL ENABLE RAPID INVENTION OF TRANSFORMATIONAL CAPABILITIES RELEVANT TO BOTH THE U.S. AIR FORCE USAF AND THE U.S. SPACE FORCE USSF THROUGH THE AGILE PURSUIT OF THE MOST IMPACTFUL RESEARCH, AS REFERENCED IN THE AF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY STRATEGY AFSTS. THE AFSTS DIRECTS AIR FORCE SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY S AND T ORGANIZATIONS TO ENABLE THE AGILITY NECESSARY FOR TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCES TO RAPIDLY EVOLVE INTO TRANSFORMATIONAL AIR FORCE CAPABILITIES. AFSTS OBJECTIVE III CALLS FOR EXPANDING THE AIR FORCES SCIENTIFIC PRESENCE IN INNOVATION HOTSPOTS, FUNDING RESEARCH IN UNIVERSITIES AND PARTNERSHIPS. THE ARRCH WILL BE LED BY A PERFORMER WHO DEMONSTRATES A VALIDATED RECORD OF RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT, BUSINESS INCUBATION ENTREPRENEURSHIP, AND WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT. THE PERFORMER WILL ENTER INTO A COOPERATIVE AGREEMENT WITH THE AIR FORCE RESEARCH LABORATORY AFRL, AND, WITH INPUT FROM AFRL, WILL IMPLEMENT A CONCEPT OF OPERATIONS ENABLING FULL AND SUBSTANTIVE COLLABORATION ACROSS A REGIONAL NETWORK OF MEMBER NODES COMPRISED OF ADDITIONAL ACADEMIC INSTITUTIONS, INDUSTRY, VENTURE FIRMS, NATIONAL LABORATORIES, AND OTHER R AND D ORGANIZATIONS. THIS COLLABORATIVE VISION LEADERSHIP WILL LEVERAGE THEIR RESPECTIVE WORLD CLASS RESEARCH, PERSONNEL, AND ENTREPRENEURIAL PROGRAMS TO CREATE A MORE PHYSICAL AND VISIBLE AF GATEWAY THAT INCREASES THE DISCOVERY, INNOVATION, AND TRANSLATION OF TECHNOLOGY OF INTEREST TO THE USAF AND USSF. A KEY CHARACTERISTIC OF THE ARRCH IS A VIBRANT RESEARCH COMMUNITY, AGILE ADMINISTRATION AND A WORKFORCE CONCEPT COMPRISED OF S AND ES FROM ALL THE MEMBER INSTITUTIONS WORKING WITHIN INTEGRATED MULTIPLE MEMBER MULTI DISCIPLINARY TEAMS TO EXECUTE JOINT RESEARCH LEVERAGING EACH OTHERS FACILITIES AND UNIQUE EXPERTISE.

column85: THE DEPARTMENT OF THE AIR FORCE DAF IS SOLICITING WHITE PAPERS FROM A UNIVERSITY THE PERFORMER TO DEVELOP AND OPERATE AN AFRL REGIONAL RESEARCH CONVERGENCE HUB ARRCH, AS A COMPLIMENT TO THE DAF CURRENT LABORATORY STRUCTURE. THE ARRCH WILL ENABLE RAPID INVENTION OF TRANSFORMATIONAL CAPABILITIES RELEVANT TO BOTH THE U.S. AIR FORCE USAF AND THE U.S. SPACE FORCE USSF THROUGH THE AGILE PURSUIT OF THE MOST IMPACTFUL RESEARCH, AS REFERENCED IN THE AF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY STRATEGY AFSTS. THE AFSTS DIRECTS AIR FORCE SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY S AND T ORGANIZATIONS TO ENABLE THE AGILITY NECESSARY FOR TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCES TO RAPIDLY EVOLVE INTO TRANSFORMATIONAL AIR FORCE CAPABILITIES. AFSTS OBJECTIVE III CALLS FOR EXPANDING THE AIR FORCES SCIENTIFIC PRESENCE IN INNOVATION HOTSPOTS, FUNDING RESEARCH IN UNIVERSITIES AND PARTNERSHIPS. THE ARRCH WILL BE LED BY A PERFORMER WHO DEMONSTRATES A VALIDATED RECORD OF RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT, BUSINESS INCUBATION ENTREPRENEURSHIP, AND WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT. THE PERFORMER WILL ENTER INTO A COOPERATIVE AGREEMENT WITH THE AIR FORCE RESEARCH LABORATORY AFRL, AND, WITH INPUT FROM AFRL, WILL IMPLEMENT A CONCEPT OF OPERATIONS ENABLING FULL AND SUBSTANTIVE COLLABORATION ACROSS A REGIONAL NETWORK OF MEMBER NODES COMPRISED OF ADDITIONAL ACADEMIC INSTITUTIONS, INDUSTRY, VENTURE FIRMS, NATIONAL LABORATORIES, AND OTHER R AND D ORGANIZATIONS. THIS COLLABORATIVE VISION LEADERSHIP WILL LEVERAGE THEIR RESPECTIVE WORLD CLASS RESEARCH, PERSONNEL, AND ENTREPRENEURIAL PROGRAMS TO CREATE A MORE PHYSICAL AND VISIBLE AF GATEWAY THAT INCREASES THE DISCOVERY, INNOVATION, AND TRANSLATION OF TECHNOLOGY OF INTEREST TO THE USAF AND USSF. A KEY CHARACTERISTIC OF THE ARRCH IS A VIBRANT RESEARCH COMMUNITY, AGILE ADMINISTRATION AND A WORKFORCE CONCEPT COMPRISED OF S AND ES FROM ALL THE MEMBER INSTITUTIONS WORKING WITHIN INTEGRATED MULTIPLE MEMBER MULTI DISCIPLINARY TEAMS TO EXECUTE JOINT RESEARCH LEVERAGING EACH OTHERS FACILITIES AND UNIQUE EXPERTISE.
